stem: A cycle rickshaw in Dhaka has a rear wheel with a diameter of 70 centimeters. On one trip, the wheel turns exactly \(1{,}500\) times without slipping. The distance the rickshaw travels on this trip is \(k\pi\) meters. What is the value of \(k\)?
solution: Each turn moves the rickshaw one circumference: \(\pi d = 70\pi\) centimeters, which is \(0.7\pi\) meters.
verify:
dd=Rational(70,100)
dist=1500*pi*dd
k=dist/pi
assert k==1050
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==k
